Messages.Author: Petri Wessman
Messages.Body:
As traditional, I'll be running a big VTES tournament at the Ropecon
gaming convention (http://www.ropecon.fi/index.php/2010/InEnglish) on
Friday July 2rd. The tournament is also the Finnish ECQ for this year.

This year we unfortunately won't have LSJ on site as GoH and fellow
player, but it should still be a fun evening of bleeds, combat, voting
and friendly angst. Also, since it's run as part of a big roleplaying
convention, there is tons of stuff to do the whole weekend.
Traditionally we've had around 80 players, but it of course varies
year to year.

The convention has a lot of English-language programming also, so
"dose dyrty furriners" are also very welcome. Last year the Swedish
delegation came over and generally kicked ass, we'll see what this
year brings. Maybe revenge ;)

The con web pages don't yet have schedules etc up, but the basic
tournament info is:

* name: Finnish ECQ 2010
* place: Ropecon 2010, Dipoli Convention Center, Espoo, Finland
* date: Friday July 23rd
* time: 18:00 onwards. Registration closes around 17:30, be there on
time!
* entry fee: free, but Ropecon entry fee is required
* rules: normal VEKN tournament rules, 3 x 2h rounds + final (yes,
final will be played in the early morning hours, coffee is your
bestest friend :)
* more info: will appear at http://vtes.orava.org

You can also pre-register by emailing me with your name & VEKN number,
that way you just have to be on site by 18:00 -- handy for people
coming from outside Helsinki.

For people coming from outside Finland: we can provide crash space on
sofa etc for some number of people coming over here on a limited
budget (Finland is expensive :/), and give tips on various travel-
related stuff. Finland is nice that time of year generally, and
Ropecon is a (very!) nice gaming convention. There are also some other
VTES tournaments on Saturday (and maybe on Sunday, not sure), so there
is plenty to do even if you're not interested in other games.

Welcome.

-Petri

Yeah!
A dish best served cold and we usually have abundance of cold to go
around :)

Seriously though, like Petri said it IS an extremely nice a convention
and focused mainly on playing stuff, as well as plenty of interesting
programme you can listen to, and it has 4000+ attendees so there's
plenty of stuff going around all the time.

I'm more than sure that, like previous years, we'll also have VTES
tournaments both on Saturday and Sunday as well.
Most likely on Saturday Tuukka will run a draft and on Sunday Jussi
"Secret Library" Hattara will run a Create-a-Clan tournament.
Plus there's plenty of casual gaming to go around for those with
insatiable hunger for VTES.

If I get my $hit together I might, once again, be running a FRP/WotC
Rage tournament (20 Renown) to get those pesky leeches under control.
So if you were one of us freaks who used to play the game why not
bring a deck for it along as well... ?

And why not have a shopping spree while you're at it?
Around here we still have sold out stuff, like Heirs to Blood
Starters, Bloodlines & Anarchs Boosters as well as 10th Anniversary
Tins available.

See you there!
Janne / Lönkka
NC Finland
